summary: Group-slug punishers bleed every opponent each turn so Sygg draws every end step and drain wins the attrition war.

tags.name: group slug
tags.reason: Iron Maiden, Viseling, Painful Quandary, Soot Imp, Rug of Smothering, Isolation Cell, Vile Consumption, and Titan Hunter bleed the whole table every turn; that bleeding is the deck's engine and clock.

tags.name: lifedrain
tags.reason: Exquisite Blood, Bloodthirsty Conqueror, Bloodchief Ascension, Gixian Puppeteer, and Parasitic Impetus convert opponent life loss into gain; attrition drain is the primary win.

tags.name: discard
tags.reason: Painful Quandary, Aclazotz, Rankle, Syphon Mind, Windfall, Whispering Madness, and Urza's Guilt force discard with Liliana's Caress and Geth's Grimoire as dedicated payoffs.

tags.name: draw
tags.reason: Sygg draws every end step someone bled; Howling Mine, Anvil of Bogardan, Scrawling Crawler, Faerie Mastermind, and Grazilaxx keep cards flowing.

tags.name: forced combat
tags.reason: Seven goad effects (Bloodthirsty Blade, Coveted Peacock, three Impetus auras, Eye of Nidhogg, Renegade Silent) point the table at each other every combat.

tags.name: group hug
tags.reason: Howling Mine, Anvil of Bogardan, and Scrawling Crawler hand everyone extra cards, but only as fuel for the hand-size punishers.

tags.name: wheels
tags.reason: Windfall and Whispering Madness are burst turns with the discard payoffs, not a wheel-every-turn engine.

tags.name: pillow fort
tags.reason: A deathtouch flyer wall plus goad redirection discourages attacks, though there are few dedicated fort pieces.

tags.name: politics
tags.reason: Curse of Verbosity and the goad suite bribe and redirect, but the deck rarely negotiates.

tags.name: reanimator
tags.reason: Reanimate, Likeness Looter, The Soul Stone, and Rise of the Dark Realms recur value, not a reanimation game plan.
